Table2 Eq(1): EARN_(t+1) = omega_0 + omega_1*EARN_t + omega_2*BKLG_t + epsilon_(t+1).
The two equations in the system are estimated using iterative weighted non-linear least squares
Similar to prior research, we jointly estimate a forecasting specification for the leading indicator and the rational expectations pricing specification.
Market efficiency is tested using a likelihood ratio statistic
For the purposes of our analyses, we assume o2 is a cross-sectional constant.
To avoid the undue influence of extreme observations we eliminate 465 firm-years in the extreme upper and lower 1% of the order backlog distribution.
EARN 1⁄4 income before extraordinary items and discontinued operations divided by average total assets.
EARNt 1⁄4 Income before extraordinary items (Compustat #18) in year t scaled by average total assets.
BKLGt 1⁄4 Backlog (Compustat #98) in year t scaled by average total assets
calculated as the arithmetic mean of total assets at the beginning and end of the fiscal year
BKLG 1⁄4 order backlog divided by average total assets.
Table2 Eq(4): SAR_(t+1) = beta_0 + beta_1*(EARN_(t+1) - omega_0 - omega_1_star*EARN_t - omega_2_star*BKLG_t) + nu_(t+1).
Body Eq(4): SAR_(t+1) = beta_0 + beta_1*(EARN_(t+1) - omega_0_star - omega_1_star*EARN_t - omega_2_star*BKLG_t) + nu_(t+1).

SAR 1⁄4 size adjusted abnormal returns computed as the buy and hold raw return minus the buy and hold return on a size matched decile portfolio of firms cumulated over 12 months beginning with the fourth month after the end of fiscal year t.
SARtþ1 1⁄4 Size-adjusted security return, measured as the realized security return from CRSP

SARtþ1 1⁄4 Size-adjusted security return, measured as the realized security return from CRSP, cumulated over 12 months beginning with the fourth month after the end of fiscal year t, minus the corresponding mean return for all CRSP firms in the same market capitalization decile at the end of year t.
